description: Agent Oversight: submit one tool or service listing (name, description, use_when, input_schema, output_schema, price, example input and output). The signed report says whether an agent can decide in seconds to call it: use-when line present, input schema complete, output schema present, price stated and example working against the schemas, each missing piece named with its fix. Supplied schemas are read, never compiled. Discovery declarations are wever_bazaar-declaration-check. Verdict not_decidable, decidable_with_gaps or decidable. POST /api/catalog-listing-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-oversight-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-oversight/.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

price.description: Price per call, such as 0.10 USDC.
